extra.description:
The HSBC Revolution Card earns 10X Rewards Points or 4 miles per S$1 spend (mpd) on online and contactless transactions across dining, shopping, and ride-hailing apps.  
This bonus earn rate is capped at S$1,500 spend per calendar month. All other spend will earn 0.4 mpd only.
Best of all, there is no annual fee.
